```rust
fn assert_node(
    nodes: &[vb_core::CompiledNode],
    id: u16,
    kind: vb_core::CompiledNodeKind,
    output: Option<vb_core::SlotIdx>,
    next: Option<vb_core::StepIdx>,
    error_slot: Option<vb_core::SlotIdx>,
    on_error: Option<vb_core::StepIdx>,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let node = nodes.get(usize::from(id)).ok_or_else(|| format!("node {id} missing"))?;
    if node.id != vb_core::StepIdx::new(id) {
        return Err(format!("node {id} has wrong id"));
    }
    if node.kind != kind {
        return Err(format!("node {id} has wrong kind"));
    }
    if node.output != output {
        return Err(format!("node {id} has wrong output"));
    }
    if node.next != next {
        return Err(format!("node {id} has wrong next"));
    }
    if node.error_slot != error_slot {
        return Err(format!("node {id} has wrong error_slot"));
    }
    if node.on_error != on_error {
        return Err(format!("node {id} has wrong on_error"));
    }
    Ok(())
}
```
